description: How a pull request may merge. One per gated pull request. The rules for which applies are the owner's (a8bc55ef).
name: merge_gate

terms.description: Merges itself once every gate is green: mode clear or complicated, and Door 1 or non-normative. In a working group only its reviewer sets it, with the quorum.
terms.label: Auto-merge

terms.description: Held for the owner to merge: mode complex, Door 2 or 3, a new dependency, a user-visible product change, or anything the builder is unsure of.
terms.label: Owner merge
